_readme: Every PNG in assets/textures is listed here with a note. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the game.

Building parts: <kind>/<style>/<name>. kind = walls, windows, doors, roofs, details (shutters, anchors, weather...), bays (wall and window baked in one image). style = regular, modern, medieval, nouveau, specialty. A style only has to be a folder: drop the PNG in and list it here. A part a style lacks is taken from regular, then specialty.
specialty/ also holds one-off textures that belong to a single model (specialty/landmarks, the crane lattice). Shops, signs, vehicles, decals, surfaces and student stay in their own folders.

Height maps (bumps): add a greyscale <name>-height.png next to <name>.png and list it here as '<key>-height'. White sticks out, black is sunk in, mid grey is flat. It is used automatically wherever <name> is used (walls, windows, doors, roofs, bays, OBJ model textures, asphalt, cobbles). Overlay height maps (windows, shutters, anchors, bands) only count where their colour PNG is painted. Strength: __tram.BUMP_SCALE / BUMP_SCALES in js/render/assets.js.
